**Volume:** T15
**Category:** 經集部類

**Byline:** 東晉 佛陀跋陀羅譯
**Dynasty:** 東晉
**Date:** 398–421
**Juans:** 2
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0618

## Contributors
- 佛馱跋陀羅 (A000441)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Dámóduōluó chán jīng* (T618, two fascicles, also styled 修行方便禪經, *Sūtra of the Means of Practice*; provisional Sanskrit *Yogācārabhūmi*) is a major Sarvāstivāda meditation manual translated by [佛陀跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BD%9B%E9%99%80%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85) (Buddhabhadra, 359–429) at Lúshān 廬山 under the patronage of [慧遠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E9%81%A0). It is among the most important meditation texts to enter Chinese Buddhism in the early fifth century and is the principal Eastern Jin counterpart to Kumārajīva's contemporaneous Cháng'ān corpus ([T613](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0250), [T614](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0251), [T616](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0253), [T617](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0254)).

**Abstract**

T618 is unanimously dated to Buddhabhadra's Lúshān period, after his expulsion from Cháng'ān (probably 410–413). The preface preserved in the *[Chū sānzàng jì jí](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0084)* (T2145, 9.65b–66c) — composed by [慧遠](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E9%81%A0) himself — describes the work as transmitted from [Dharmatrāta 達摩多羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%94%E6%91%A9%E5%A4%9A%E7%BE%85) and [Buddhasena 佛大先](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BD%9B%E5%A4%A7%E5%85%88), two great *yogācāra* masters of Kashmir; modern scholarship (Demiéville 1954; Yamabe 1999) has confirmed that the text is closely related to fragments of [Saṅgharakṣa 僧伽羅叉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%83%A7%E4%BC%BD%E7%BE%85%E5%8F%89)'s *Yogācārabhūmi* (cf. [T606](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0243) *Xiūxíng dàodì jīng*) and represents a Sarvāstivāda Kashmiri tradition transmitted independently of, but parallel to, the line received at Cháng'ān by Kumārajīva. Confusion in later Chán historiography led to T618 being mis-identified as the work of [Bodhidharma 菩提達摩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E9%81%94%E6%91%A9), the Indian patriarch of the Chán school — a misattribution corrected already by [僧祐](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%83%A7%E7%A5%90) Sēngyòu but persisting in popular usage.
